description: Immutable facts established when a run starts.

input_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical input crash dump, for dedup and proof
input_sha256.title: Input Sha256

origin.description: How the run was requested, e.g. 'POST /api/v1/analyze'. Recorded so a run triggered by a test or a script is distinguishable from one an operator started.
origin.title: Origin

provenance.description: REAL | SYNTHETIC | SYNTHETIC_FROM_REAL_METADATA | DEMO | UNKNOWN. Normalized on construction: an unrecognised value becomes UNKNOWN, never REAL.
provenance.title: Provenance

scenario_id.description: Catalogue scenario id, when the input was one
scenario_id.title: Scenario Id

source_type.description: Display label DERIVED from provenance, never authored
source_type.title: Source Type
